title: Bulb's Strange Giople
description: An odd entity that roams the plains and wears a mask!
body:
![Bulb's Strange Giople!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1bd19b49854493f196b8d568f315b90167c26f5b.png)

This is the Giople!
it is a strange turtle esque creature that roams the plains at night!
it has twice as much health as an iron golem and can kill a player in a single hit!
HOWEVER.. it's reward for killing it is better than netherite!
The mask that grants you sound-ific abilities!!!!.
